Class BalpXmlSerializationStrategy

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.support.audit.marshal.BalpXmlSerializationStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
SerializationStrategy
public class BalpXmlSerializationStrategy extends Object
Serializes ATNA audit messages as XML-encoded FHIR R4 AuditEvent resources. Configure it as the serializationStrategy of the audit context to have audit records written in the shape that IHE BALP and the AuditEvent profiles of the IHE transactions define.
Since:
4.1
Author:
Christian Ohr

  • Constructor Details

    • BalpXmlSerializationStrategy

      public BalpXmlSerializationStrategy()
      Uses a newly created R4 FhirContext. Prefer BalpXmlSerializationStrategy(FhirContext) whenever the application has one already: a FhirContext is expensive to create and meant to be shared.

    • BalpXmlSerializationStrategy

      public BalpXmlSerializationStrategy(FhirContext fhirContext)
      Parameters:
      fhirContext - the FhirContext whose XML parser serializes the AuditEvents. Must be an R4 context.

      public void marshal(AuditMessage auditMessage, Writer writer, boolean pretty) throws IOException

      public AuditEvent translate(AuditMessage auditMessage)
      Converts an ATNA audit message into the AuditEvent resource representing it, either through the AuditEvent the audited transaction's profile defines or, failing that, generically.

      Returns:

    • auditEventInstance

      public AuditEvent auditEventInstance(String auditEventClassName)
      Returns a new instance of AuditEvent. The class is named rather than referenced because the transaction-specific AuditEvents live in the modules of their transactions, which this module is a dependency of and not the other way round.
      Parameters:
      auditEventClassName - fully qualified name of an AuditEvent subclass with a public no-arg constructor, or null
      Returns:
      AuditEvent instance matching the FHIR transaction, or a plain AuditEvent if no class name was given
      Throws:
      ClassCastException - on misconfiguration

      Converts a participant object of the audit message into an entity of the AuditEvent. The participant object ID becomes entity.what, as a literal reference if it reads like one and as an identifier otherwise.

    • activeParticipantToAgent

      protected AuditEvent.AuditEventAgentComponent activeParticipantToAgent(ActiveParticipantType ap)
      Converts an active participant of the audit message into an agent of the AuditEvent. An active participant whose role ID codes encode the claims of an access token becomes the OAuth agent BALP defines for it; everything else is mapped element by element.
      Parameters:
      ap - active participant
      Returns:
      the corresponding agent
